Riva

An AI receptionist that answers a small business's calls in English or French, books appointments, drafts quotes and follows up by text.

Private. Walkthrough on request at support@lemonshops.app.How to useIn motion

01

Problem

Tradespeople and small clinics miss calls while they work. Most callers who reach voicemail call a competitor, and answering services are expensive and generic.

02

What it does

Each call is answered, transcribed and summarized. The caller is saved as a contact, a quote is drafted and a follow-up text is queued; the owner approves with one tap. The website has a live voice demo, pages per industry, pricing and booking. A specialist handles the setup, so the owner needs no technical skills.

03

How it is built

A conversational voice agent connected to the business's number, with transcription, summaries and a pipeline that creates the contact and the quote. The website is built with React and TypeScript.

04

In motion

Four frames that summarize the platform. Click to advance.
